requestedIntent: Offer an explicit opt-in speed helper for reversible contained work without treating installation as ACEF admission or governing ordinary repository-native execution.
limitations: Installation alone is inert. Raw commands and agent use are never intercepted without an active ACEF lifecycle; the speed limits are enforced only after a caller explicitly invokes acef-native-test.
A stable --work-unit is caller-supplied only when independently admitted children share a branch and HEAD; ordinary native work keeps the zero-configuration default budget.
The 10-minute budget measures actual execution time of explicitly wrapped verification commands, not agent reasoning, read-only inspection, or unwrapped repository-native work.
Broad closeout is intentionally allowed once on a clean worktree and may run for up to 30 minutes because it is a separate batch-level certification action, not native implementation feedback.

evidence.note: Covers isolated named-work-unit budgets and successful focused verification receipts.
